description: Test suite for line group key resolution functions, including lookup, configuration, history key, account-scoped groups, and group policy logic.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupLookupIds
methods.description: Expands a raw group or room id into an array with prefixed candidates.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupConfigEntry
methods.description: Matches group config entries based on raw, prefixed, or wildcard identifiers.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupHistoryKey
methods.description: Determines the shared LINE peer key from group or room id.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupsConfig
methods.description: Resolves the effective account-scoped groups map from configuration.

methods.name: resolveExactLineGroupConfigKey
methods.description: Finds the exact configuration key for a given groupId within an account context.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a group requires mention based on config, supporting account scoping.
